svg.title: The product of the one-dimensional Gaussian integrals gives R C = 1, also for dv = 0. This proves the dormant factor and its normalization used in the previous integral identity. The remaining volume constants can be checked by actual finite set partitions. If r is the color dimension, h is the number of active free links, and f is the total number of free tree-gauge links, then p = rh, the number of dormant coordinates is dv, and the ambient fluctuation dimension is p + dv. The number of frozen free links is f-h. Define mg = c( √ 2π g)r, where c is the Haar chart scale. The chart/rescaling prefactor satisfies the exact identity
